outline:
以住宅空間內容為主體，學習空間丈量實務與放樣，並練習繪製平面系統施工圖及立面系統施工圖，認識基礎材料符號,各種現場施作.....等施工大樣圖說，熟悉室內空間規劃，家具設計之造形與櫃體等施工圖完整繪製。
This is the lecture of furniture engineering drawing technique and related knowledge, It emphases on the main difference between furniture engineering drawing and normal engineering drawing. The aim is for students to present the detailed construction and main parts of their furniture design product by drawing.
